desc:
Count your steps before you make your step...

🎭 Nothing Is What It Seems — Trust your eyes at your own risk.
💀 Devious Troll Traps — Every step could be your last.
🏆 Gears & Glory — Use powerful gears like the Slap and Magic Carpet to survive the madness, reach the finish, and unlock the ultimate **Rebirth**!
